class.name: SteamStats
class.brief_description: Reads and updates the signed-in player's published Steam stats and achievements.
class.description: Get this service from [method SteamClient.stats] after Steam starts. It reads Steam's local cache for the current app. Use [method edit] to collect changes and [method SteamStatsEdit.submit] to request persistence once.

method.name: achievement
method.description: Returns a detached snapshot of the named achievement, or [code]null[/code] if the name or cache cannot be read.

method.name: achievements
method.description: Returns a typed array of readable achievement snapshots. Returns an empty array if the Steam stats cache is unavailable or there are no entries.

method.name: clear_achievement
method.description: Clears an unlock in the signed-in player's local cache. Use on controlled test data or as part of a game reset. Call [method store] to request persistence.

method.name: edit
method.description: Returns an empty draft. This call has no effect on the Steam cache.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns whether the active client scope exposes the Steam User Stats interface on the main thread.

method.name: set_stat_float
method.description: Sets an absolute finite float in the local cache within Steam's single-precision range. Call [method store] to request persistence.

method.name: set_stat_int
method.description: Sets an absolute signed 32-bit integer in the local cache. Call [method store] to request persistence.

method.name: show_progress
method.description: Requests a Steam overlay progress popup for a locked achievement. The current count must be positive and below the maximum, which fits an unsigned 32-bit integer. The popup leaves the cached unlock state unchanged.

method.name: stat_float
method.description: Reads a cached float or average-rate stat. Check [member SteamResult.ok] before using its value. The result reports an invalid name, an unavailable interface, or a missing stat of the requested type.

method.name: stat_int
method.description: Reads a cached signed 32-bit stat. Check [member SteamResult.ok] before using its value. The result reports an invalid name, an unavailable interface, or a missing stat of the requested type.

method.name: store
method.description: Requests persistence of changed stats and achievements. [constant @GlobalScope.OK] means Steam accepted the local request. Use [signal stats_stored] to observe the app-wide backend response.

method.name: unlock_achievement
method.description: Marks the named achievement unlocked in the signed-in player's local cache. Call [method store] to request persistence and the unlock notification.

method.name: update_average_rate
method.description: Updates an average-rate stat in the local cache. The accumulated count must be finite within Steam's float range and the duration must be finite and positive. Call [method store] to request persistence.

signal.name: achievement_stored
signal.description: Emitted when Steam reports an achievement unlock or a progress popup for the active app. Both progress counts are zero for a complete unlock.

signal.name: stats_stored
signal.description: Emitted with Steam's native result for a store or achievement progress event. This is an app-wide event shared by matching Steam scopes.
